synopsis: Maintenance technician found un-installed engine bolt during maintenance troubleshooting due to jamb of engine twist grip.
narrative: Engine bolt located after jamb of #1 engine twist grip and subsequent trouble shooting with magnet in inaccessible area adjacent to engine idle cutoff inner bellcrank. Bolt appears to be un-installed with anti-seize present and no safety wire installed in head of 12-point engine bolt. Last engine maintenance in area Day 1 per documented maintenance records. Installation if engine verified. No other FOD found. Use of borescope, visually thru open panels, or magnet after disassembly/reassembly of engine components with performed.

evidence.quote: Bolt appears to be un-installed with anti-seize present and no safety wire installed in head of 12-point engine bolt.

sequence.desc: 부품 미장착, 잘못된 부품, 정비 작업의 결함
